# rwedev

Development tools for the RWE package ecosystem: create, update and check
packages against the shared standards. Development use only: never list
rwedev in the Imports of a domain package.

This first version is the package skeleton. Its only function,
`rwe_standards_version()`, returns the version of the RWE standards it
implements. The planned tools and their status are in
[docs/rwedev.md](https://github.com/UMC-Utrecht-RWE/rwe-ecosystem/blob/main/docs/rwedev.md).

## Installation

```r
pak::pak("UMC-Utrecht-RWE/rwe-ecosystem/rwedev")
```

## Usage

```{r}
rwedev::rwe_standards_version()
```
